messages:
ravi: trying to cut a patch for sample-sdk but CI blocked on regendiff. it flags that method overload ordering changed in generated client.ts which triggered a semver bump.
release-bot: publish job 904 blocked: regendiff mismatch detected -> https://ci.redwood.example/904
morgan: method ordering? that shouldn't be a breaking change. paste diff?
ravi: small snippet: ```diff
- export function fetchResource(id: string): Promise<Resource>
- export function fetchResource(opts: {id: string, retry?: number}): Promise<Resource>
+ export function fetchResource(opts: {id: string, retry?: number}): Promise<Resource>
+ export function fetchResource(id: string): Promise<Resource>
```
alejandra: ah, the typegen stable-sort was removed in the last refactor so overloads reorder nondeterministically on some platforms -> regendiff shows churn and our semver bot treats reorder as removal/add.
ravi: workaround: revert to previous codegen hash in package.json to get stable output. not great.
morgan: temp fix: add canonical ordering step post-regen: `node scripts/stable-overload-sort.js` that normalizes overload order. I'll PR it to the regen pipeline.
typegen-bot: artifact for job 904: https://artifacts.redwood/904/regendiff.txt
alejandra: also filing issue: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/issues/1501 "typegen: overload ordering nondet causes semver churn". tagging sdk-parity, ci-blocker.
release-bot: note: changelog-generator bumped minor because it detected "signature removal" in API diff.
morgan: we should tweak changelog-generator to ignore pure reordering when signatures set is identical. easier short-term than changing semver heuristics.
alejandra: agreed. long-term fix: restore deterministic sort in codegen and add snapshot test that fails if public API set changes.
ravi: thanks — PR up for canonical sorter and changelog tweak: https://git.redwood/eng/devex/pulls/2247. merging will unblock the publish.
release-bot: rerun: job 904 now passing regendiff check on PR 2247 preview run.
morgan: follow-up: add a line in release playbook: "always run `yarn typegen:preview && node scripts/stable-overload-sort.js` locally before opening SDK PRs".
alejandra: will add CI test and a tiny note in CONTRIBUTING.md. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
